authorisedInInputCountry.note: No gambling licence claim was found on the site to check against Spain's DGOJ register or any other regulator, because the site does not appear to offer real-money wagering. No DGOJ blocklist entry or Spain-specific enforcement action naming lotteryusa.com was found via search of ordenacionjuego.es and general news.

contradictions: No evidence was found that lotteryusa.com targets Spain: no Spanish-language version was located, no EUR pricing, and its content is limited to US state lottery results/tools — inconsistent with the premise that it is an illegal gambling site targeting the Spanish market.

lotteryusa.com is easily confused with the similarly-named but distinct and unaffiliated 'Lottery.com Inc.' (NASDAQ: LTRY, rebranded SEGG Media Corporation in 2025), which faced SEC fraud charges and related litigation over 'sham transactions.' Search results confirm these are separate companies (one an informational lottery-results site since 1995, the other a lottery-courier company that went public via SPAC); the SEC/fraud news pertains to Lottery.com/SEGG Media, not to lotteryusa.com or DNStination Inc., and has been excluded from the news section to avoid misattribution.

The WHOIS registrant (DNStination Inc.) may be a technical domain-registration/holding entity rather than the confirmed publisher/operator of the site; the site's own Terms of Use refer only to an unnamed 'the Company,' and the page could not be independently fetched (403) to resolve this.

priority.rationale: Based on all available public information, lotteryusa.com functions as a US lottery-results/information aggregator (results, numbers, statistics, and third-party courier-service reviews) rather than a real-money gambling operator. It shows no Spanish-language content, no EUR/local payment integration, and no evidence of targeting the Spanish market; it makes no discoverable gambling-licence claims to check against Spain's DGOJ or any other regulator. Enforcement resource against this target for the Spanish jurisdiction appears misdirected absent further evidence; recommend confirming the original flagging rationale (e.g., was a specific page, ad, or courier-affiliate link accessed from Spain?) before allocating investigative resources.

factors.harmAndExposure: No evidence of traffic from Spain, Spanish-language content, EUR pricing, or localized marketing; the content is US state-lottery specific.
factors.consumerHarmSeverity: The site itself does not appear to accept deposits or bets; it is a results/info/comparison site. Independent scam-check aggregators (Scamadviser, Scam Detector, Scamdoc) rate it as low-risk/legitimate and long-established (domain since 1995).
factors.legalReachability: Registrant (DNStination Inc.) and hosting (Google LLC, US) are both US-based and identifiable at a surface WHOIS level, but the true publishing/operating entity's legal name, registration number, and any relationship to DNStination Inc. remain unconfirmed due to blocked page access.
factors.actorBehaviorIntent: No mirror domains, no history of Spain-specific evasion, no prior Spanish regulatory warnings found. Long-standing single domain (since 1995) with no rotation pattern typical of evasive illegal operators.
factors.feasibilityCost: Given the apparent absence of any wagering activity or Spain-targeting, an enforcement action would have low likelihood of a meaningful or durable regulatory outcome and carries reputational/collateral risk of pursuing a non-gambling informational publisher.
factors.strategicValue: Little deterrent or precedent value in pursuing an apparent informational aggregator; resources are better directed at the courier/wagering services it reviews (e.g., Jackpot.com, which markets itself as allowing betting on lotteries 'from anywhere') if those independently target Spain.

analystNotes: Per the pre-investigation guidance, this brief specifically assessed whether lotteryusa.com is a real-money gambling operator or an information aggregator. All corroborating evidence (site description across multiple independent secondary sources, scam-check aggregator profiles, and the nature of its '/couriers/' section which reviews third-party lottery-courier apps like Jackpocket, Jackpot.com, Lotto.com and Mido Lotto rather than itself processing wagers) points to lotteryusa.com being a US lottery-results/information and affiliate-content site, not itself a gambling operator taking bets or deposits. Direct fetches of the homepage, /about-us/, /terms/, and WHOIS aggregator pages all returned HTTP 403 (bot-blocked), so all findings rely on search-indexed snippets and third-party directory/aggregator data — this is a material limitation and every fact here should be re-verified with direct/manual browsing or a compliant scraping method before any enforcement step is taken. No connection to Spain (language, currency, marketing, DGOJ listing, or news) was found. Recommend: (1) reconfirm why this URL was flagged for Spain — check the specific referral/complaint source; (2) if the actual concern is a courier or betting service reachable via links from lotteryusa.com (e.g., Jackpot.com, which advertises betting on lotteries 'from anywhere'), open a separate investigation targeting that service directly against Spain's DGOJ register; (3) if pursuing lotteryusa.com's corporate identity further, attempt direct browser-based access or a California Secretary of State business-entity search for 'DNStination Inc.' to confirm registration status and officers, since search alone could not retrieve a registry entry.
